{{External|rsc=Medium Bronze Helmet|rs=Bronze med helm|dw=Bronze Helmet}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bronze med helm |image = [[File:Bronze med helm.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A medium sized helmet. |value = 24 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 1139 }} [[File:Bronze med helm detail.png|left|130px]] [[File:Bronze med helm chathead.png|left]] The '''bronze med helm''' is the weakest [[medium helmet]]. It can be equipped to give a player small [[Defence]] bonuses in [[combat]]. Players can make a bronze med helm with a [[Smithing]] level of 3 by using one [[bronze bar]] on an [[anvil]] with a [[hammer]] in their inventory, giving the player 12.5 Smithing [[experience]]. Players can purchase this medium helmet from [[Peksa]]'s [[Helmet Shop]] in the [[Barbarian Village]] or in the [[Warrior Guild Armoury]] from [[Anton]]. A bronze med helm is required for the [[Black Knights' Fortress]], [[King's Ransom]], and [[While Guthix Sleeps]] quests. A bronze med helm [[Item spawn|spawn]] exists in the south-eastern corner of [[Draynor Manor]]. [[Falador]] and [[Edgeville]] [[guard|town guards]] wear these helms as part of their uniform; as well the [[Fortress Guard|Black Knights' Fortress' guards]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -3 |arange = 0 |dstab = +3 |dslash = +4 |dcrush = +2 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +3 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = head |image = [[File:Bronze med helm equipped.png]] |altimage = [[File:Bronze med helm equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 3 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 12.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Bronze bar |output1 = Bronze med helm }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Bronze med helm}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Bronze med helm|location=[[Draynor Manor]] ({{FloorNumber|uk=0}})|members=No|3122,3360|leagueRegion=Misthalin}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Bronze med helm|location=[[Draynor Manor]] (Count Draynor's basement)|members=No|mapID=12|3077,9778|leagueRegion=Misthalin}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Bronze med helm}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The medium helmet's ranged attack bonus has been increased from -1 to 0. }} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2007 |update = Game Improvements (July 2007) |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Bronze med helm detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Bronze med helm detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Bronze med helm (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Bronze med helm.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
